data.short_description: The June Club is bringing a private members' club to a historic Federal Reserve Building in Downtown Jacksonville's North Core. The space will include multiple levels with restaurants, lounges, private dining, a library/meeting mezzanine, and a basement cabaret with nightly entertainment. It is part of the broader redevelopment of the North Core area.

data.short_description: Finjan, a new craft cafe, will open inside Lahasa Quickmart in the Produce Junction shopping center in Glenside. data.status: official opening date not yet announced; special event ahead of grand opening on Oct. 1
data.short_description: Chef Camari Mick, a James Beard Award semifinalist, will open her own concept, Calabash, an Afro-Caribbean brasserie and bakery, in the West Village this fall. The restaurant will serve pastries and coffee by day and a prix fixe dinner menu by night, without alcohol. A special event for Chase Sapphire Reserve cardholders is planned for Oct. 1 ahead of the grand opening.

data.status: "Official opening date coming soon" / "getting closer to opening our doors"

The brand emphasizes fresh, locally sourced ingredients with no oils and full nutrition tracking. An Instagram post says an official opening date is "coming soon."
